{{Quote|This was not the main hangar that was used for shuttles and transports, but a hangar bay located deep in the middle of the mountain with no direct launch or landing site.|Personal journal of Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="Field Report">{{WEGCite|story=Field Report|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''Emergency Shuttle Hangar''' was a small [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in the upper levels of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] that was originally built to serve as an emergency escape route for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] while in residence. 

==History==
The hangar served as an emergency escape route for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> It was destroyed in an [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|attack]] on [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Smugglers' Alliance]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TLCS" />

Several [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]] after the destruction of the mountain, the [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Garv Debble]] and his [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]<ref name="Erasing All Traces">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> of the [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]]<ref name="TLCS" /> undertook an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] expedition known as the [[Mount Tantiss dig]].<ref name="Field Report" /> The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] later mentioned the hangar in<ref name="Field Report" /> his<ref name="CSWE Na'al">{{CSWECite|II|351|Na'al, Voren}}</ref> [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]].<ref name="Field Report" />

==Layout==
The shuttle hangar was located in the upper levels of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], below the [[Throne Room Complex (Wayland)|Throne Room Complex]] and [[Royal Chambers]], which could be accessed via a private [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] and a staircase.<ref name="TTTS" /> This bay was equipped with a single specially modified [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] that was known to have been equipped with a much more advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] (supposedly capable of reaching the x1/2 [[hyperdrive barrier]]). It was also rumored that this personal escape vessel was equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]], but this was considered unlikely considering that Mount Tantiss itself only contained plans for a cloaking device instead of actual working models.<ref name="TLCS" />
